verdict.rationale: Segment's Engage/Audiences product explicitly supports building audiences from real-time tracking events, traits, and computed traits, then syncing them continuously to hundreds of ad and engagement destinations, powered by real-time identity resolution (segment-docs-9, 23, 32, 43, 53). This covers the core of continuous audience activation with dynamic membership. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actual sync latency or entry/exit behavior in practice, and no explicit documentation of exact refresh cadence or SLAs for near-real-time membership changes.
